scope: Native isolated Play Mode, streaming audio and world-label rendering; no room or account writes.

PASS Fixed world text is discovered by the existing label presenter
PASS Near captions are readable; distant captions stop rendering
PASS Screen HUD is excluded from distance fading
PASS Afternoon switches to the warmer score
PASS Evening switches to the uneasy score
PASS Night switches to the suspense score
PASS Local pursuit switches to the urgent hunt score
PASS Ending a pursuit returns to the current world mood without stacking tracks
PASS Both score voices use the existing Music volume mixer
PASS Capture/cinematic focus ducks the score for SFX and instructions
PASS Connection recovery fades the score to silence
